sources.markSeenTitle: Mark the current content as already handled
sources.markSeenConfirm:
Mark everything currently in “{name}” as already handled?

Those messages will never be forwarded.
sources.moveLabel: Move: the message is deleted from the mailbox once delivered
sources.copyLabel: Copy: the message stays on the POP3 server
sources.moveWarning: In move mode the source mailbox is emptied as it goes. The messages will only exist at the destination, so make sure it works first.
targets.title: Destinations
targets.accountAddressHint: For reference: the mailbox is the authorized account's
targets.appPasswordHint: App password, not your account password
targets.imapBody: It is filed into the folder as is, without going through an outgoing server: original sender, signature and attachments preserved. This is the only mode where Gmail does not present collected messages as sent by you.
targets.apiTitle: Untouched, and run through your filters
targets.apiBody: The message is imported into the mailbox instead of being re-sent: the original sender is preserved, just like the IMAP drop. But Gmail runs it through its delivery pipeline, so your filters, the category classifier and the spam check all apply. In exchange, you authorize access once through Google rather than using an app password.
targets.gmailPasswordBody: Your account password is rejected. Enable two-step verification, then generate a 16-character app password and paste it below.
oauth.connected: Google account connected. Reconnect it if you change your Google password.
oauth.notConnected: Google account not connected yet: fill in the client credentials, then authorize access.
oauth.redirectHint: Declare this in the Google console as an authorized redirect URI:
advanced.title: Advanced settings
advanced.neverSpam: Never mark as spam (disarms Gmail's filter)
advanced.boxAddressHint: Used for the trace headers. Empty = the IMAP username.
advanced.newMessageId: Regenerate the Message-ID (only if Gmail hides duplicates)
mode.redirectHelp: The message goes out untouched: original sender, signature and attachments. For servers that accept sending on behalf of a third party.
mode.gmailSafeHelp: Gmail rewrites the sender anyway, so we do it cleanly: “Original name (via the mailbox)” is displayed and the real sender goes to Reply-To.
